title: Zoom-blur tunnel NLE transition
blurb: One ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas transitions between two live HTML scenes through a hyperbolic barrel zoom-blur tunnel anchored at a draggable focal point, with warm and cool lens dispersion and projective hit-testing.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas drive an NLE radial zoom-blur tunnel transition between two live interactive HTML scenes around a draggable optical focal point, keeping buttons and text inputs hit-testable at both settled endpoints?
result: Measured in HeadlessChrome/160.0.0.0 (2026-11-27): all six live checks pass with 0 console errors at 412 px (DPR 2.625, 1.096 MP canvas, 8.77 MB initial, 13.63 MB peak across checks) and 1080 px desktop (DPR 2, 1.556 MP). Relocating the focal anchor from (0.18, 0.22) to (0.82, 0.78) flipped quadrant contrast from 10.7 vs 2.3 to 1.7 vs 10.7, and elementsFromPoint() plus clicks hit controls at 0% and 100%.
